special_traits.name: Hold Breath
special_traits.description: The hydra can hold its breath for 1 hour.

special_traits.name: Multiple Heads
special_traits.description: The hydra has five heads. Whenever

special_traits.name: the hydra takes 25 damage or more on a single turn, one of its heads dies
special_traits.description: The hydra dies if all its heads are dead. At the end of each of its turns when it has at least one living head, the hydra grows two heads for each of its heads that died since its last turn, unless it has taken Fire damage since its last turn. The hydra regains 20 Hit Points when it grows new heads.

special_traits.name: Reactive Heads
special_traits.description:
For each head the hydra has beyond
one, it gets an extra Reaction that can be used only for Opportunity Attacks.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description:
The hydra makes as many Bite attacks as it
has heads.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description:
Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 10 ft. Hit: 10 (1d10
+ 5) Piercing damage.
